children.text: Zitch will collect and use the details you provide in this form to create and secure your account, verify your identity, support transactions, protect against fraud, and contact you about your account when needed.

This may include your name, email address, phone number, BVN or NIN, and your transaction PIN settings. Your information is handled for onboarding, security, support and compliance purposes, under the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023.
Please review the full Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions before continuing.
